_doc: ANTI-DUPLICATION MAP for the marketplace test bank. Declares which DERIVED obligations (see transition_matrix.json) are ALREADY locked by a registered gate, so the bank never rebuilds a slower copy of a passing test. Hand-authored from READING each gate's live output - every claim carries the gate's own check text as evidence, so a wrong claim is visible and challengeable rather than silently inflating coverage. This is the MK kill-list discipline applied to tests: expansion means net-new measurable ground, never renaming.
_rule: A cell may be marked covered_by ONLY when the named gate asserts that exact (table, from, to, authority) obligation. 'Related' is not 'covered'. When in doubt the cell stays UNCOVERED - an over-claim here is the false-100 this whole platform keeps having to dig out.
_verified: 2026-07-29, by running each gate and reading its printed checks (not by grepping its source).

covers.evidence: legal path works + journal writes (requested -> broadcasting, 2 events)
illegal jump blocked (requested -> completed refused for the client)
covers.note: All non-allow-listed transitions are ONE equivalence partition - the guard's catch-all raise. One representative suffices; enumerating 116 illegal pairs would be padding.

covers.evidence: top-up self-verify is a no-op (row stays pending_verification) + provider self-verification blocked
covers.note: prefix claim: covers every authority-negative on the topup verify transition

covers.evidence: first-accept-wins proven with 2 concurrent psql clients; loser gets lost_race_or_closed
covers.note: The accept itself is RPC-mediated so it is not a guard-derived transition; the concurrency proof is recorded against the first provider-chain step it protects.

covers.evidence: a duplicate GCash reference is refused (partial unique index bites)
a second commission for one request is refused (one_commission_per_request)
26 live rolled-back invariants incl. cross-hive read/write refusal + attribution pinning
covers.note: SUFFIX claim: covers the cross-tenant authority partition across every transition. Deliberately broad and stated as such - if a transition ever needs a bespoke cross-tenant proof, it gets its own cell.

uncovered_summary._measured: 20 derived positives; 4 have a gate. 16 positives are UNPROVEN in the authorised direction.
the_gap: The entire provider execution chain: accepted->en_route->on_site->in_progress->completed (4 positives). No gate proves the matched provider CAN advance a job; C1 only proves illegal jumps are refused.
All 8 cancel transitions (5 client-side, 3 provider-side). A cancel that silently fails, or one that works for the WRONG party, would pass every gate today.
completed->settled (the client confirms payment - the transition that mints commission).
marketplace_listings *->published positive (admin CAN publish); only the non-admin refusal is locked.
uncovered_summary.honest_reading: The platform is well covered on REFUSAL and thinly covered on PERMISSION. That asymmetry is expected - every one of those gates was written after a security finding, so they encode 'this must not happen'. Nothing yet asserts 'this must still work', which is exactly how a guard tightened one notch too far ships silently. The bank's first real value is the positive direction.
